expect: the mode near 708 cm^-1 (written V-O2 in the shift sentence; V-O2-V in the mode list): ~5 cm^-1 red shift; the V-O2 mode near 303 cm^-1 had a 1 cm^-1 blue shift (p3.L49-52)
question: Which Raman mode showed the largest mean red shift when the V2O5 film was prestrained, by how much, and which mode shifted the other way?
rendered: The V−O2 (∼708 cm−1) Raman mode showed the largest mean red shift of ∼5 cm−1 when the V2O5 film was prestrained. The V−O1 (∼997 cm−1) Raman mode showed a mean red shift of ∼2 cm−1, and the V−O3−V (∼483 cm−1) Raman mode showed a mean red shift of ∼3.5 cm−1. The V−O2 (∼303 cm−1) Raman mode showed a mean blue shift of 1 cm−1.
